review_reference: Owner decision Q43 of 2026-11-11 (OCR learning: rules switch on only after 5 identical corrections from 3 staff, suggestions only, sensitive classes excluded, kill switch per rule set) and the coordinator's answers of the same day; to be signed by the owner (0118 first).
evidence: Migration 0118 only. 0118_ocr_correction_observations.sql plus its runtime-grants.sql block. WHAT IT DOES: two new tables in schema ocr, granted to no runtime role (row-level security forced, one owner policy each): ocr.learning_key (one row, a 32-byte key made by the migration with gen_random_bytes; no deployment secret, coordinator decision of 2026-11-11) and ocr.correction_observations (facility, field class, SHA-256 digest of the value the AI reading gave, the closed-list value the reviewer saved or NULL, HMAC-SHA-256 of the staff account under that key, HMAC of the validation id, time; the digest itself is stored as its HMAC under the key, so no row can be checked against guessed text or joined to a validation without the key). Nothing read from a paper is stored: ocr-api sends a digest, never the text, and only drug-list, strength, frequency-code, lab-test and lab-unit values. Two SECURITY DEFINER functions: ocr.record_correction_observations (OCR API; a staff session holding ocr.validation.write, its own accepted validation of the last 10 minutes, at most 200 well-formed entries, idempotent per validation and key; also deletes rows older than 180 days) and ocr.purge_correction_observations (OCR worker account only; 180-day retention, oldest first). KEY NOTE: database dumps and backups carry the HMAC key with the rows; the key only pseudonymises staff counts (it never identifies anyone by itself and protects no patient data), so this is accepted. BACKWARD COMPATIBLE: nothing existing changes; today's ocr-api, ocr-worker and identity-api images never call the new functions. LOCKS: only the new tables and SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE on identity.facilities (the foreign key); no existing row read or written. TESTS: services/ehr-api/test/database/ocr-correction-observations.integration.sql (42 cases as the exact runtime roles: grants, forced RLS, no table privilege, the HMAC, refusals for another facility/membership/old/rejected validation, malformed lists, purge).
